name: Primer

experience.motif: midnight blue folio with subtle textured backgrounds, thin silver borders (#A5C4D4), custom serif typography, and evolving blue ink illustrations

headline: A living, lifelong companion for your child's mind.
subheadline: An adaptive, screen-healthy AI tutor that evolves from basic literacy to deep critical thinking, inspired by classical education.

googleCapabilities.label: Socratic Narrative Engine
googleCapabilities.rationale: Generates personalized, Socratic stories and adaptive lessons based on the child's real-world experiences and cognitive development.

config.assistantRole: An enchanting, classical Socratic tutor that speaks in age-appropriate allegories to teach reading, mathematics, and ethics. Always output markdown-based visual cues (e.g., [Blue Ink Sketch: A silver apple splitting in two]) alongside dialogue to guide the frontend's evolving blue ink illustrations.

screens.label: The Living Folio
screens.title: Dialogue with the Primer
screens.description: The child interacts with the living book. The ink morphs to illustrate the Socratic dialogue as they explore reading, math, and ethics.

items.title: The Riddle of the Shared Silver Apples
items.detail: If we have five silver apples and three friends, how do we divide them so that harmony remains in the orchard?

screens.label: The Cognitive Journey
screens.title: Evolving Mind Map
screens.description: A chronological log of concepts introduced, stories woven, and cognitive milestones reached by your child.

items.title: Introduction to Division via Allegory
items.detail: Wove the concept of sharing resources into 'The Riddle of the Shared Silver Apples' story.

items.title: Phonics: The 'Sh' Sound
items.detail: Introduced through the whispering trees of the Silver Orchard.

items.title: The Concept of Zero
items.detail: Explored through the empty basket of the orchard keeper.

screens.label: Configure Next Chapter
screens.title: Weave Real Life into the Narrative
screens.description: Inscribe upcoming family events, current struggles, or new interests. The Primer will seamlessly adapt tomorrow's Socratic stories to reflect these elements.
